ext_name.description: Extension name in the store (max 45 characters)

ext_description.message: Adds an MP3 button under YouTube videos. One click sends the video to the free Tunegrab app for Windows.

w_subtitle.message: MP3 in one click, right from YouTube

w_step1_text.message: The extension only passes the link; the free Tunegrab app for Windows downloads and converts the audio. Download it and open it once.

w_step2_text.message: Next to the Like button you'll see a new MP3 button. On Shorts and playlists it floats in the bottom-right corner. You can also right-click a YouTube link, or click the Tunegrab icon in the toolbar.

w_step3_text.message: The first time, your browser asks whether to open Tunegrab. Tick "Always allow" and click Open. After that, one click is enough.

w_privacy.message: Privacy: the extension doesn't collect, store or send any data. It only reads the address of the YouTube page when you click it.

w_more.message: Help, source code and updates on GitHub
